description: Call before `npm install` or `pip install`: one verdict (ok / caution / avoid) with plain reasons and a 0-100 risk score. Checks that the package exists (catches hallucinated names), typosquats of popular packages, brand-new releases (72 h supply-chain cooldown), install scripts, deprecated or yanked versions, licence, repository, weekly downloads and known vulnerabilities of that exact version (OSV) with the fixed version. Up to 25 packages per call, live registry data, ~0.3-1.5 s. Built for AI coding agents and CI. Free: 25 calls/day per IP. Paid: $0.003 per call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/package-safety-check.

packages.description: Instead of name: up to 25 items like 'npm:lodash@4.17.4', 'pypi:requests==2.19.0', 'express'

version.description: Exact version or npm dist-tag (default: latest)
